english.note: Use this when the remark explicitly points out or draws attention to an observed fact, especially in more formal speech or writing.
This is the all-purpose choice when explicitly pointing something out or directing someone's attention to it.
Use this when identifying a problem or issue as relevant or important.
Use this when the comment takes the form of pointing out a fact, problem, or consequence.

examples.english: The report goes on to remark that this plan is risky.
examples.traditional: 份報告指出，呢個計劃有風險。
